title: Linguistically-Tailored Mobile Intervention for the Improvement of Follow Up for Abnormal Pap Test Results
brief_summary: This clinical trial evaluates the feasibility of a linguistically-tailored mobile intervention, called CervixChat in improving the follow-up of patients with abnormal Papanicolaou (pap) test results. A text messaging program, such as CervixChat may support patients who need a colposcopy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female, aged 21 to 65 years of age
* Had received an abnormal Pap smear result
* Scheduled colposcopy
* Able to communicate with ease in English or Spanish
* Have a cell phone with text (TXT) ability
* Competent to give consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Are pregnant at the time of recruitment
* Display current evidence of positive invasive carcinoma of the cervix
